title: New Medical Guidelines Update Migraine Prevention Strategies
subtitle: Leading experts share updated advice on how to manage and prevent frequent, painful headaches.

summary.en: Medical experts have released updated guidelines for migraine prevention, marking the first major change since 2012. The new advice focuses on a wider range of treatment options, including newer drugs that target specific proteins. Doctors are now encouraged to offer preventive care to patients who experience four or more migraine days each month. These recommendations aim to help patients choose treatments based on effectiveness, safety, and personal needs. The guidance is based on a large review of over 200 scientific studies.
summary.zh: 醫學專家已發布更新後的偏頭痛預防指南，這是自二〇一二年以來的首次重大變革。新建議聚焦於更廣泛的治療選擇，包括針對特定蛋白質的新型藥物。醫師現在受鼓勵為每月偏頭痛發作四天或以上的病患提供預防性照護。這些建議旨在協助病患根據有效性、安全性與個人需求選擇治療方式。該指南是基於對超過兩百項科學研究的大規模回顧所制定。

paragraphs.en: For millions of people living with the intense pain of migraines, finding the right treatment is a difficult challenge. Now, for the first time since 2012, the American Academy of Neurology (AAN) and the American Headache Society (AHS) have released updated medical guidelines to help doctors and patients navigate this process. These new recommendations reflect the many changes in medical science that have occurred over the last decade, particularly the arrival of new drugs designed to stop migraines before they start.
paragraphs.zh: 對於數百萬飽受偏頭痛劇烈疼痛之苦的人來說，找到合適的治療方法是一項艱鉅的挑戰。如今，自二〇一二年以來，美國神經學會（American Academy of Neurology, AAN）與美國頭痛學會（American Headache Society, AHS）首次發布了更新後的醫療指南，旨在協助醫師與病患應對此一過程。這些新建議反映了過去十年來醫學科學的諸多變革，特別是那些旨在於偏頭痛發作前就將其阻斷的新藥問世。

paragraphs.en: According to MedPage Today, the updated guidance is based on a systematic review—a careful study of all available scientific evidence—of 217 different research papers. Dr. Rebecca Burch, one of the authors of the new guidelines, explained that the medical field has seen a "wealth of new treatment" options since the previous advice was published. These new options include a group of medicines that target a protein called CGRP, which is known to play a major role in causing migraine pain.
paragraphs.zh: 根據醫學新聞網站 MedPage Today 的報導，這份更新後的指南是基於對兩百一十七篇不同研究論文進行系統性回顧（即對所有現有科學證據進行審慎研究）的結果。新指南的作者之一柏奇醫師（Dr. Rebecca Burch）解釋說，自上一版建議發布以來，醫學界已出現了「豐富的新治療」選擇。這些新選擇包括一組針對特定蛋白質（稱為降鈣素基因相關胜肽，簡稱 CGRP）的藥物，已知該蛋白質在引發偏頭痛疼痛方面扮演關鍵角色。

paragraphs.en: In the past, doctors often relied on older medications, such as those used to treat seizures or high blood pressure, to help prevent migraines. While these remain part of the conversation, the new guidelines provide a much clearer picture of how newer, specialized treatments compare to these traditional options. For example, the review found strong evidence that drugs like galcanezumab and erenumab are effective at reducing how often patients experience migraine attacks. Other treatments, including Botox and various oral medications, were also shown to be helpful for many patients.
paragraphs.zh: 過去，醫師常依賴舊型藥物（例如用於治療癲癇或高血壓的藥物）來預防偏頭痛。雖然這些藥物仍是討論的一部分，但新指南更清晰地呈現了較新的專業治療與這些傳統選項之間的比較。例如，該回顧發現強有力的證據顯示，如加卡奈珠單抗（galcanezumab）與依瑞奈單抗（erenumab）等藥物，在減少病患偏頭痛發作頻率方面相當有效。其他治療方式，包括肉毒桿菌素（Botox）與多種口服藥物，也被證實對許多病患有所助益。

paragraphs.en: One of the most important parts of the new guidance is the expanded definition of who should receive preventive care. Dr. Burch noted that doctors should now offer these treatments to anyone who experiences four or more migraine days per month, or four or more days of moderate-to-severe headache pain. This also applies to patients whose condition makes it difficult to work or complete their daily tasks. By setting these clear standards, the AAN and AHS hope to ensure that more people get the help they need to improve their quality of life.
paragraphs.zh: 新指南中最重要的部分之一，是擴大了應接受預防性照護的對象定義。柏奇醫師指出，醫師現在應為每月有四天或以上偏頭痛，或有四天或以上中度至重度頭痛的人提供這些治療。這也適用於那些因病情而難以工作或完成日常任務的病患。透過設定這些明確的標準，美國神經學會與美國頭痛學會希望確保更多人能獲得所需的協助，以改善生活品質。

paragraphs.en: Unlike the older 2012 guidelines, this update focuses on the specific needs and priorities of the patient. The authors emphasize that choosing a treatment is not just about which drug is the most powerful. Instead, doctors are encouraged to discuss several factors with their patients, including the potential side effects, the long-term safety of the medicine, and the cost of the treatment. This patient-centered approach recognizes that what works for one person might not be the right choice for another.
paragraphs.zh: 與二〇一二年的舊指南不同，此次更新聚焦於病患的特定需求與優先事項。作者群強調，選擇治療方式不僅僅是看哪種藥物最強效。相反地，醫師受鼓勵與病患討論多項因素，包括潛在副作用、藥物的長期安全性以及治療成本。這種以病患為中心的方針承認，對某人有效的方法，未必是另一個人的正確選擇。

paragraphs.en: While the new guidelines offer a clearer path forward, the research also highlights that there is still more to learn. The systematic review noted that while many individual drugs have been studied, there are fewer studies that directly compare one drug against another. This means that doctors and patients must continue to work closely together to monitor how well a chosen treatment is working and make adjustments if necessary.
paragraphs.zh: 雖然新指南提供了更清晰的前進方向，但研究也強調仍有許多未知之處。系統性回顧指出，儘管許多單一藥物已受到研究，但直接比較不同藥物之間差異的研究卻較少。這意味著醫師與病患必須持續密切合作，監測所選治療的效果，並在必要時進行調整。

paragraphs.en: Ultimately, the goal of this update is to provide a modern, evidence-based roadmap for managing a condition that affects the daily lives of so many people. By combining established, older treatments with the latest scientific breakthroughs, medical professionals hope to reduce the frequency and severity of migraines for patients everywhere. As medical technology continues to advance, these guidelines will serve as a vital tool for ensuring that patients receive the most effective and appropriate care available today.
paragraphs.zh: 最終，此次更新的目標是為管理這種影響許多人日常生活的疾病，提供一份現代化且基於證據的藍圖。透過結合既有的舊型治療與最新的科學突破，醫療專業人員希望能降低全球病患偏頭痛的發作頻率與嚴重程度。隨著醫療技術持續進步，這些指南將成為確保病患獲得當前最有效且適切照護的重要工具。

previousArticles.title: New Medical Guidelines Offer Hope for Migraine Patients
previousArticles.summaryEn: Medical experts have released new guidelines for preventing migraines for the first time since 2012. The update reflects a wave of new medications that have entered the market in recent years. Doctors are now encouraged to offer preventive care to more patients who struggle with regular headaches. These treatments aim to reduce the frequency of attacks and improve daily quality of life. However, experts note that access to these drugs remains a challenge for many people.

quiz.question: According to the new guidelines, which patients are now specifically recommended to receive preventive migraine care?

options.A: Anyone who has ever experienced a migraine attack in their lifetime.
options.B: People who experience four or more days of moderate-to-severe headache pain per month.
options.C: Patients who have failed to respond to treatments for high blood pressure or seizures.
options.D: Only those patients who are unable to work due to the high cost of medical treatments.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第四段，Dr. Burch 明確指出醫生應為每月有四天或以上偏頭痛，或四天以上中度至重度頭痛的患者提供預防性治療。選項 A 過度擴張，文章並未包含所有偏頭痛患者；選項 C 混淆了過去的用藥歷史與目前的建議標準；選項 D 錯誤地將經濟因素與治療資格掛鉤，文章提到的是「無法完成日常任務」，而非單純因為費用問題。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the shift in medical philosophy between the 2012 guidelines and the new update?

options.A: The new guidelines prioritize the most powerful drugs over patient preferences to ensure faster results.
options.B: The 2012 guidelines focused exclusively on CGRP-targeting proteins, which are now considered outdated.
options.C: The new update values individual patient circumstances, such as side effects and costs, more than the previous version.
options.D: Doctors are now discouraged from using older medications like those for high blood pressure.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第五段，更新後的指南強調「以病人為中心」（patient-centered approach），不再僅僅追求藥效，而是綜合考量副作用、長期安全性與成本。選項 A 與文章內容矛盾，因為文章強調不只是選最強的藥；選項 B 錯誤，因為 CGRP 藥物是新進展，而非 2012 年的舊觀點；選項 D 不正確，文章第三段提到傳統藥物仍然是討論的一部分，並未被棄用。

quiz.question: In the second paragraph, what does the phrase 'wealth of new treatment' imply?

options.A: A large and varied number of available options.
options.B: Expensive medical procedures that only the wealthy can afford.
options.C: The financial success of pharmaceutical companies.
options.D: A limited selection of highly specialized drugs.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在文中，「wealth of」在此處並非指「財富」，而是指「豐富、大量」的意思（a wealth of = an abundance of）。選項 B 是對「wealth」一詞的字面誤解；選項 C 雖然在現實中可能發生，但並非文中該詞組所要表達的醫學進展意涵；選項 D 則與「wealth」所代表的「豐富數量」意思完全相反。

quiz.question: What is the primary purpose of the updated migraine treatment guidelines?

options.A: To prove that newer drugs are always superior to traditional medicines.
options.B: To provide a modern, evidence-based framework for managing migraine care.
options.C: To encourage patients to stop seeing doctors and manage migraines independently.
options.D: To list every available migraine medication currently on the market.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文章最後一段總結，更新的目的是提供一個現代化、基於科學證據的藍圖（roadmap），以幫助醫療專業人員管理偏頭痛。選項 A 過於絕對，文章提到的是比較與選擇；選項 C 與文章強調「醫生與患者密切合作」的觀點相反；選項 D 錯誤，文章並未列出所有藥物清單，而是提供治療建議與標準。
